changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists(select Uid from AssetType where UID = '00000001-0000-0000-0000-A00000000011') begin insert into AssetType (Name, Description, Class, DisplayFormat, State, Hierarchical, HierarchyMaximumDepth, Object, ObjectID, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, UpdatedOn, UpdatedBy, Uid) values ('User', 'A resource account.', 11, '{FirstName} {LastName}', 1, 0, 0, 'ResourceType', 1, getutcdate(), 0, getutcdate(), 0, '00000001-0000-0000-0000-A00000000011') end GO if not exists(select Uid from AssetType where UID = '00000001-0000-0000-0000-B00000000012') begin insert into AssetType (Name, Description, Class, DisplayFormat, State, Hierarchical, HierarchyMaximumDepth, Object, ObjectID, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, UpdatedOn, UpdatedBy, Uid) values ('Group', 'A security group.', 12, '{Name}', 1, 0, 0, 'GroupType', 1, getutcdate(), 0, getutcdate(), 0, '00000001-0000-0000-0000-B00000000012') end GO if not exists(select Uid from AssetType where UID = '0000000A-0000-0000-0000-000000000009') begin insert into AssetType (Name, Description, Class, DisplayFormat, State, Hierarchical, HierarchyMaximumDepth, Object, ObjectID, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, UpdatedOn, UpdatedBy, Uid) values ('Reference List', 'A reference list.', 12, '{Name}', 1, 0, 0, 'ReferenceItemType', 0, getutcdate(), 0, getutcdate(), 0, '0000000A-0000-0000-0000-000000000009') end GO update T set T.SubjectUid = S.[uid] from [IntersectType] T inner join AssetType S on S.Object = T.Subject and S.ObjectID = T.SubjectID GO update T set T.ObjectUid = S.[uid] from [IntersectType] T inner join AssetType S on S.Object = T.Object and S.ObjectID = T.ObjectID GO update IntersectType set SubjectUid = '0000000A-0000-0000-0000-000000000009' --reference where Subject = 'ReferenceItemType' and SubjectID = 0 GO update IntersectType set ObjectUid = '0000000A-0000-0000-0000-000000000009' --reference where Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and ObjectID = 0 GO
changeSet.rollback: delete AssetType where UID = '00000001-0000-0000-0000-A00000000011' GO delete AssetType where UID = '00000001-0000-0000-0000-B00000000012' GO delete AssetType where UID = '0000000A-0000-0000-0000-000000000009' GO update IntersectType set SubjectUid = NULL where SubjectUid = '0000000A-0000-0000-0000-000000000009' GO update IntersectType set ObjectUid = NULL where ObjectUid = '0000000A-0000-0000-0000-000000000009' GO
